llm_condensed_answer:
SUMMARY: The change requires replacing variadic Object arguments with a typed TypeRegistration struct in the AddKnownTypes method. This affects all projects that register custom CRD types by calling scheme.AddKnownTypes(), requiring updates to those call sites. The breaking changes would occur in files across cert-manager, external-secrets, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry Operator that currently use the old method signature.

FILES:
- cert-manager/pkg/apis/certmanager/v1/register.go — Registers cert-manager CRD types using AddKnownTypes
- cert-manager/pkg/apis/certmanager/v1alpha2/register.go — Registers cert-manager CRD types using AddKnownTypes
- cert-manager/pkg/apis/certmanager/v1alpha3/register.go — Registers cert-manager CRD types using AddKnownTypes
- cert-manager/pkg/apis/certmanager/v1beta1/register.go — Registers cert-manager CRD types using AddKnownTypes
- external-secrets/pkg/apis/externalsecrets/v1beta1/register.go — Registers external-secrets CRD types using AddKnownTypes
- grafana-operator/pkg/apis/monitoring/v1/register.go — Registers Grafana CRD types using AddKnownTypes
- opentelemetry-operator/pkg/apis/opentelemetry/v1alpha1/register.go — Registers OpenTelemetry CRD types using AddKnownTypes
